::: {#exm-adjacent}
#### Neighbors in the office graph

In the office graph (@exm-office-graph),
the neighbors (@def-adjacent) of $b$ are $a$, $c$ and $d$.
The vertices $a$ and $f$ are not adjacent, since no edge has endpoints $a$ and $f$.
In the graph of @exm-loop-parallel, the loop at $p$ makes $p$ adjacent to itself.

:::
